imu_reference.quality: Manufacturer nominal camera-to-IMU transform; absolute CAD location inherits approximate lens-opening camera origin

coordinate_conventions.cad: millimetres, Y up; component placements preserved
coordinate_conventions.model: CAD rotated +90 degrees around X to make Z up
coordinate_conventions.optical_frame: OpenCV: X right, Y down, Z forward
coordinate_conventions.mujoco_camera: OpenGL: X right, Y up, negative Z forward
coordinate_conventions.imu: Local X right, Y forward, Z up; quaternions rotate local IMU to magnetic/gravity world, not the OptiTrack world

limitations: CAD lens opening is a reference origin, not a calibrated optical centre.
Native MuJoCo rendering is pinhole and does not apply OpenCV distortion.
Visual-only meshes: no mass, hinge or collision model is provided.
